+import asyncio, copy
+from uuid import uuid4
+from datetime import timedelta
+import prefect.server.worker_communication.cleanup_queue.memory as memory
+from prefect.server.worker_communication.cleanup_queue import get_worker_cleanup_queue
+from prefect.client.schemas.worker_channel import CANCELLING_TIMEOUT_TEARDOWN, PENDING_CLAIM_TEARDOWN
+from prefect.settings import temporary_settings
+from prefect.settings import (
+    PREFECT_SERVER_WORKER_CHANNEL_CLEANUP_QUEUE_STORAGE as STORAGE,
+    PREFECT_SERVER_WORKER_CHANNEL_CLEANUP_LEASE_SECONDS as LEASE,
+    PREFECT_SERVER_WORKER_CHANNEL_CLEANUP_MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS as MAXD,
+    PREFECT_SERVER_WORKER_CHANNEL_CLEANUP_COMPLETED_IDEMPOTENCY_RETENTION_SECONDS as RET,
+)
+
+fixed = {"t": memory.now("UTC")}
+def fake_now(tz="UTC"): return fixed["t"]
+memory.now = fake_now
+
+async def main():
+    # factory raises for interface pkg
+    with temporary_settings({STORAGE: "prefect.server.worker_communication.cleanup_queue"}):
+        try:
+            get_worker_cleanup_queue(); assert False
+        except ValueError as e:
+            assert "concrete WorkerCleanupQueue implementation" in str(e), str(e)
+    q = get_worker_cleanup_queue()
+    await q.clear()
+    wp = uuid4(); wq = uuid4()
+    target = {"flow_run_id": str(uuid4())}; data={"k":[1,2]}
+    mid = uuid4()
+    r1 = await q.enqueue(mid, "idem1", wp, CANCELLING_TIMEOUT_TEARDOWN, target, data, wq)
+    assert r1.message_id == mid
+    # mutate caller dict -> stored unaffected
+    target["flow_run_id"]="MUT"; data["k"].append(99)
+    stored = await q.read_message(wp, mid)
+    assert stored.target["flow_run_id"] != "MUT", stored.target
+    assert stored.data["k"] == [1,2], stored.data
+    # idempotent
+    r2 = await q.enqueue(uuid4(), "idem1", wp, CANCELLING_TIMEOUT_TEARDOWN, {"x":1})
+    assert r2.message_id == mid
+    # wakeup incremented on new enqueue
+    assert await q.read_wakeup_sequence(wp) == 1, await q.read_wakeup_sequence(wp)
+
+    with temporary_settings({LEASE: 30.0, MAXD: 3, RET: 3600.0}):
+        res = await q.reserve(wp)
+        assert res.message_id == mid
+        assert res.delivery_count == 1
+        assert res.lease_expires_at == fixed["t"] + timedelta(seconds=30.0)
+        assert len(res.reservation_token) > 32
+        # second reserve -> None (active)
+        assert await q.reserve(wp) is None
+        # unauthorized work pool
+        assert (await q.ack(uuid4(), mid, res.reservation_token)).reason == "work_pool_mismatch"
+        # invalid token
+        assert (await q.ack(wp, mid, "bad")).status == "invalid_token"
+        # renew ok
+        rn = await q.renew(wp, mid, res.reservation_token)
+        assert rn.status == "accepted" and rn.lease_expires_at == fixed["t"]+timedelta(seconds=30)
+        # ack accepted -> tombstone
+        ack = await q.ack(wp, mid, res.reservation_token)
+        assert ack.status == "accepted"
+        assert await q.read_message(wp, mid) is None
+        # re-enqueue within retention -> same id
+        r3 = await q.enqueue(uuid4(), "idem1", wp, CANCELLING_TIMEOUT_TEARDOWN, {"x":1})
+        assert r3.message_id == mid, r3
+        # after retention expiry -> new id
+        fixed["t"] = fixed["t"] + timedelta(seconds=4000)
+        r4 = await q.enqueue(uuid4(), "idem1", wp, CANCELLING_TIMEOUT_TEARDOWN, {"x":1})
+        assert r4.message_id != mid, r4
+    print("PART1 OK")
+
+    # release + dead letter
+    await q.clear()
+    with temporary_settings({LEASE: 30.0, MAXD: 2}):
+        m = uuid4()
+        await q.enqueue(m, "k", wp, PENDING_CLAIM_TEARDOWN, {"a":1})
+        res = await q.reserve(wp); assert res.delivery_count==1
+        rel = await q.release(wp, m, res.reservation_token, "boom")
+        assert rel.status == "accepted", rel
+        res2 = await q.reserve(wp); assert res2.delivery_count==2, res2
+        assert res2.reservation_token != res.reservation_token
+        rel2 = await q.release(wp, m, res2.reservation_token, "boom2")
+        assert rel2.status == "dead_lettered" and rel2.reason=="max_delivery_attempts_reached", rel2
+        dl = await q.read_dead_letter(wp, m)
+        assert dl.final_delivery_count == 2 and dl.release_reason=="boom2", dl
+        assert await q.read_dead_letter(uuid4(), m) is None
+    print("PART2 OK")
+
+    # preferred queue + expire + wakeup
+    await q.clear()
+    with temporary_settings({LEASE: 30.0, MAXD: 5}):
+        ma=uuid4(); mb=uuid4()
+        await q.enqueue(ma, "a", wp, PENDING_CLAIM_TEARDOWN, {}, work_queue_id=uuid4())
+        pref=uuid4()
+        await q.enqueue(mb, "b", wp, PENDING_CLAIM_TEARDOWN, {}, work_queue_id=pref)
+        res = await q.reserve(wp, preferred_work_queue_ids=[pref])
+        assert res.message_id == mb, res
+        # let it expire
+        seq_before = await q.read_wakeup_sequence(wp)
+        fixed["t"] = fixed["t"] + timedelta(seconds=100)
+        exp = await q.expire_leases(work_pool_id=wp)
+        assert any(r.message_id==mb for r in exp.redelivered), exp
+        assert await q.read_wakeup_sequence(wp) > seq_before
+        # renew expired -> expired + wakeup
+        m2=uuid4(); await q.enqueue(m2,"c",wp,PENDING_CLAIM_TEARDOWN,{})
+        res=await q.reserve(wp)
+        fixed["t"]=fixed["t"]+timedelta(seconds=100)
+        seqb=await q.read_wakeup_sequence(wp)
+        rr=await q.renew(wp, res.message_id, res.reservation_token)
+        assert rr.status=="expired", rr
+        assert await q.read_wakeup_sequence(wp) > seqb
+    print("PART3 OK")
+
+    # wait_for_wakeup
+    await q.clear()
+    seq0 = await q.read_wakeup_sequence(wp)
+    async def waiter(): return await q.wait_for_wakeup(wp, after=seq0, timeout=5)
+    task = asyncio.create_task(waiter())
+    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
+    await q.enqueue(uuid4(), "w", wp, PENDING_CLAIM_TEARDOWN, {})
+    w = await task
+    assert w is not None and w.work_pool_id==wp and w.sequence>seq0, w
+    # timeout -> None
+    cur = await q.read_wakeup_sequence(wp)
+    assert await q.wait_for_wakeup(wp, after=cur, timeout=0.1) is None
+    print("PART4 OK")
+
+asyncio.run(main())
+print("ALL OK")
